program: Wingless external raw-input to representation to predictive-relation frontier
question: Do relationships between externally learned raw-byte motifs remain predictive on untouched external suffixes, rather than only supporting local next-byte prediction?
hypothesis: Learn the unchanged 512-motif representation from the first floor(0.60*N) bytes of each verified external source. Decode non-overlapping motif occurrences in those prefixes and estimate a motif-to-next-motif transition relation within each source boundary. On the untouched final 40% suffixes, the learned conditional relation will outperform a pooled motif-unigram baseline in top-1 next-motif accuracy on at least two of three sources, with positive pooled accuracy gain and no source-identity, contamination, tokenizer, model-call, or capacity-growth failures.

portfolio_context.frontier: external raw bytes -> learned motif representation -> source-derived relation
portfolio_context.reason_for_gate: Establish that the relation to be composed later is itself learned from and stable on external content before testing multi-step relation composition.

prior_evidence.interpretation: The interface chain works under a controlled relation law; R1 now moves the relation itself onto external content.

scope_statement: This experiment tests source-derived sequential relations between learned raw motifs. It is a relation-induction/holdout gate, not yet a multi-step reasoning claim.

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host must be distinct from LINKDEADKB

frozen_input_protocol.representation_train_split: first floor(0.60*N) bytes of each source
frozen_input_protocol.motif_index: selected motifs sorted lexicographically by exact four-byte key after frozen R2 selection
frozen_input_protocol.motif_stream_decode: scan left-to-right; when the next four raw bytes exactly match a selected motif emit its motif ID and advance four bytes; otherwise advance one byte; reset at every source boundary
frozen_input_protocol.relation: directed transition from each emitted motif ID to the immediately next emitted motif ID within the same decoded source stream
frozen_input_protocol.train_relation: transition counts and pooled next-motif unigram counts from decoded 60% prefixes only
frozen_input_protocol.holdout_relation: decoded 40% suffixes are scoring-only and never update counts, ranking, capacity, thresholds, or stopping

relation_learner.state: 512 x 512 uint32 conditional next-motif counts plus 512-entry pooled next-motif unigram counts
relation_learner.prediction: for a current motif, choose the highest-count conditional successor; ties choose lowest motif ID; if the current motif has zero training outgoing count, use the unigram argmax
relation_learner.baseline: pooled training next-motif unigram argmax for every query

classification_rules.supported: All validity criteria and frozen thresholds pass.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and pooled conditional relation accuracy exceeds the unigram baseline, but one or more per-source support thresholds fail.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but pooled conditional relation accuracy does not exceed the unigram baseline.
classification_rules.invalid: Any authority, source identity, split contamination, representation drift, relation-definition drift, capacity, determinism, or host-isolation criterion fails.
classification_rules.incomplete: Authority, source retrieval, or hosted compute interruption prevents the frozen matrix.

validity_criteria: Exact sealed parent and North Star identities match.
A fresh CKB-plane READY_RESEARCH receipt is bound to this exact preregistration commit and external manifest.
All source hashes and exact byte lengths match before learner construction.
The 512-motif representation learner is scientifically identical to the qualified external prediction gate.
Motif decoding and transition counting use training prefixes only; suffix bytes are scoring-only.
Every source boundary resets motif decoding and no transition crosses a source boundary.
Conditional relation and unigram baseline receive identical training relation events.
Full Go regression passes before the probe; duplicate probes are byte-identical; all metrics are finite.
No tokenizer, semantic parser, external model, persistent corpus, capacity growth, LINKDEADKB execution, production authority, or post-result tuning occurs.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter source bytes, hashes, 60/40 split, 512-motif representation mechanics, motif-stream decoding, relation definition, fallback behavior, baseline, metrics, thresholds, classification, or authority requirements after any primary output.
